Use the contractor's project update (doc PRJ-0412) to send a brief status email to ops-lead@acme.example.

From: Liam Achterberg <l.achterberg@vantage-retail.example>
Subject: Checkout page freezes on Safari
To: support@acme.example

Hello,

On Safari 18 the checkout page freezes after entering a discount code. The spinner keeps
turning and the order is never submitted. Chrome works fine. This started on 2026-11-07.

Best,
Liam

Please keep me posted on the fix, and let me know if you need screenshots.
